method: Sequential seven-card offscreen workload; Qt Quick software renderer; three seconds warmup; ten seconds per simulated phase. CPU includes reaped child CPU. PSS covers the main process only. Voluntary context switches are not kernel wakeup counts. Desktop power/lock state and preferences were not changed.
interpretation: This short run supports lower paused workload and fewer voluntary context switches. Normal active CPU increased and memory remained similar; it does not establish an overall CPU reduction, native desktop performance or energy savings. Saver and paused labels are simulated: the old revision does not react to them. Lock/display checks continue in the updated paused state. Real multi-monitor hotplug remains untested; automated topology, scale, restoration and transition race checks passed.
